title: Harden session_cost transcript edge cases without changing valid reports
rubric: Malformed token counts are handled per the prompt: missing/None means zero, positive integer counts are accepted, and strings, booleans, floats, negatives, or other non-integers skip the whole record without crashing.
Unknown model accounting is robust for non-string model values, ignores placeholder labels beginning with <, and never lets unknown or malformed records reserve a duplicate message id.
Message-id deduplication is applied only to accepted priced records, with first accepted priced record winning and id-less or non-string-id priced records counted independently.

The public unique_messages value means unique accepted priced messages, including accepted priced records without string ids and excluding unpriced, placeholder, malformed, zero-usage, and duplicate-priced records.
Absolute --include glob patterns are expanded deterministically, missing globs do not crash, and existing relative include, directory include, and path de-duplication behaviour remains intact.
sources.subagent_transcripts and markdown source text count only unique task-dir .output files, never arbitrary --include files, while files_scanned still includes every scanned file.
All price and counterfactual expectations continue to be computed from data/pricing.json at run time, with no hardcoded prices, model ids, or pricing dates.
Existing valid transcript pricing, markdown/JSON shape, --no-subagents behaviour, read-error handling, and test_session_cost.py regressions remain green.
